title: Gamma Ray Burst Photon-Level Dataset
purpose: A2 dataset is specifically created to build a large sample of simulated gamma-ray bursts generated with a GenAI model.

provenance.sources: Photon event data generated from GRB simulations via Generative AI models trained on Fermi-LAT data.
provenance.processing: Photon events extracted with associated arrival times (relative to trigger) and energies. Data cleaned to remove spurious detections and calibrated for energy measurements.
provenance.derivations: Derived quantities include the reconstructed photon time and energy.

quality.validation: Events were generated using a trained Generative AI model and validated through statistical consistency checks against the reference simulated dataset. Data integrity verified through CSV file validation and statistical checks on key parameters.
limitations: The dataset reflects the statistical properties learned from the training simulations and may not capture rare or extreme physical scenarios outside that domain
Temporal and spectral features are model-dependent and may inherit biases from the training dataset
Instrumental systematics and detailed detector response effects are not explicitly simulated unless encoded in the training data
quality.usageGuidance: This dataset is recommended for algorithm development, pipeline testing, and machine learning training.

access.reuseGuidance: Users must cite this dataset when using it in publications or derivative works. Commercial use is permitted. Modified versions should clearly indicate changes from the original dataset.
